scenes.script_line: [B2] From the booking, they're already our guest — every email answered quickly and warmly builds their confidence.

scenes.script_line: [B3] The arrival: the first fifteen minutes set the emotional tone. A genuine welcome, a cold drink — you made it, you can let go now.
scenes.visual_direction: Guests step out of a car and receive cold drinks and real smiles under a pergola; shoulders visibly drop. Medium wide, golden afternoon. [image-beat]

scenes.script_line: [B4] The first morning: waking without an alarm, rosemary in the air, breakfast as a statement of identity.
scenes.visual_direction: Morning light through linen curtains onto a bed, then a farm breakfast: fresh bread, preserves, eggs laid that morning. Detail-rich, sensory. [image-beat]

scenes.script_line: [B5] The days: freedom. Surf, horseback riding, hiking — or pool, book, wine, repeat. Both are perfect stays.
scenes.visual_direction: The two rhythms: surfers on an Atlantic beach and riders on a trail, intercut with a woman reading by a pool with a glass of wine. Wide + medium. [image-beat]

scenes.script_line: [B6] A child who feeds a goat at eight in the morning has already made the family's holiday.
scenes.visual_direction: A small child feeding a goat or chickens, parents watching with delight; unforced farm joy. Low angle at child height, morning light. [image-beat]

scenes.script_line: [B7] A rainy day at Craveiral should be remembered as the cosiest day of the trip, not the lost one.
scenes.visual_direction: Rain streaking a window, then inside: a crackling fireplace, a heated indoor pool, a long lazy lunch. Contrast beat — storm outside, warmth inside.

scenes.script_line: [B8] The farewell: never let a departure be reduced to an invoice. The last image should feel like leaving a friend's house.
scenes.visual_direction: Hosts wave as a car rolls down the drive; a small gift from the farm handed through the window; a look back in the mirror. Warm wide, late light. [image-beat]

shots.text: hosts waving as a car rolls down a drive, late light

scenes.script_line: [B9] After: the review they'll write, the memory that ripens over months, and the return.
scenes.visual_direction: Back home, a guest smiles at photos on their phone, writes a review, a jar of farm jam on the city kitchen counter — the stay travelling onward. Medium detail.

scenes.script_line: [B10] Nobody is outside the journey. It's a relay — and the baton is the guest's trust.
scenes.visual_direction: The team as a chain: housekeeping, kitchen, reception and maintenance in seamless motion, one handing off to the next through the day. Medium tracking energy.
